title: Separating Thinking from Spelling for Efficient Generative Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2610.32980v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative recommenders retrieve items by writing their semantic IDs (SIDs) code by code under trie-constrained beam search, an approach now deployed on large web platforms. Standard autoregressive interfaces pay for the SID length K twice: a history of T items enters the backbone as TK code tokens, and every beam-search step runs through the backbone, so returning B candidates costs O(BK) backbone decode tokens per user. The second cost often dominates, and it grows with the backbone, the SID depth and the candidate budget.   We introduce Deco (decoding from concepts), which separates reading the history from writing the identifier. The backbone reads each history item as one fused token and condenses the history once into a compact next-item concept; a light KV-cached decoder conditioned on the concept and the generated prefix runs the entire beam search, while the identifiers, the trie and the autoregressive factorization stay unchang

translated_title: 将思考与拼写分离以实现高效的生成式推荐
translated_abstract: 生成式推荐器通过在Trie树约束的束搜索下逐码书写物品的语义标识符（SID）来检索物品，这一方法目前已部署于大型网络平台。标准的自回归接口为SID长度K付出了双倍代价：T个物品的历史序列以TK个代码token的形式进入骨干网络，且每一次束搜索步骤都要经过骨干网络，因此为每个用户返回B个候选需要O(BK)个骨干网络解码token。第二项开销通常占据主导地位，并随骨干网络规模、SID深度和候选预算的增长而增长。我们提出了Deco（从概念解码，decoding from concepts），将阅读历史与书写标识符相分离。骨干网络将每个历史物品读取为一个融合token，并将历史一次性压缩为紧凑的“下一物品概念”；一个轻量的、带KV缓存的解码器以该概念和已生成前缀为条件运行整个束搜索，而标识符、Trie树以及自回归分解保持不变。
tldr: 该论文提出Deco方法，将阅读用户历史与书写物品标识符的过程解耦——骨干网络将历史一次性压缩为紧凑的“下一物品概念”，再由轻量的KV缓存解码器独立执行整个束搜索，从而大幅降低生成式推荐中随骨干规模、SID深度和候选数量增长的解码开销。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Deco, which separates reading the user history from writing item identifiers—the backbone condenses the history once into a compact next-item concept, and a lightweight KV-cached decoder independently runs the entire beam search, dramatically reducing decoding costs that grow with backbone size, SID depth, and candidate budget in generative recommendation.
